'''Pickled mushrooms''' are pickled [[Braised Mushroom|braised mushrooms]]. They heal {{Value|Pickled Mushrooms|heals}} and have no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pickled_mushrooms.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A braised mushroom, a brown mushroom and a glass bottle. Obtaining a braised mushroom unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating pickled mushrooms takes {{Value|Pickled Mushrooms|eat_time}} and heals {{Value|Pickled Mushrooms|heals}}. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.
